note: Every downloaded file, by explicit URL, with its sha256 (filled in by tools/acquire.py). Entries with 'member' are single files read from a remote zip by HTTP Range; the sha256 is of the extracted member and crc32 is the zip's own checksum. raw/ is gitignored.

cmu.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
cmu.licence: Free for all uses (site statement); do not resell the data itself
cmu.credit: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
cmu.format: ASF/AMC, 120 Hz (subjects 62 and 79: 60 Hz); lengths in inches/0.45

files.note: stationary: lifts and holds a 19.5 lb suitcase (pelvis displacement 0.05 m)

accad.name: ACCAD Open Motion Project (The Ohio State University)
accad.credit: Open Motion Project by ACCAD/The Ohio State University, CC BY 3.0 (https://accad.osu.edu/research/motion-lab/mocap-system-and-data).

100style.name: 100STYLE (Mason, Starke, Komura 2022)
100style.credit: 100STYLE dataset, I. Mason, S. Starke, T. Komura, 'Real-Time Style Modelling of Human Locomotion via Feature-Wise Transformations and Local Motion Phases', 2022; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.8127870, CC BY 4.0.

cml.name: Construction Motion Data Library (CML), public version
cml.credit: Tian, Li, Cui, Chen, 'Construction motion data library: an integrated motion dataset for on-site activity recognition', Scientific Data 9, 726 (2022); figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.20480787.v3, CC BY 4.0.
cml.caveat: CML merges processed samples from several upstream datasets (CMU, HDM05 CC BY-SA 3.0, Berkeley MHAD, CAD60, SBU, in-lab Perception Neuron). Each card records the upstream source where the file states it; HDM05-derived samples are treated as class B (share-alike) and are not used.
cml.format: JSON, 20-joint skeleton, 30 Hz, metres; members of Construction_Related_Data.zip (zip md5 e0c1e12fa74d072e423239a908473668)

niosh_roofing.name: NIOSH residential roofing datasets (CDC data.cdc.gov)
niosh_roofing.licence: Public domain (US Government work, CC public domain mark)
niosh_roofing.credit: NIOSH, 'Video-based 3D pose estimation for residential roofing' dataset, doi 10.26616/NIOSHRD-1042-2022-0; NIOSH, 'Agreement of hip kinematics between two tracking marker configurations ... during ergonomic roofing tasks', doi 10.26616/NIOSHRD-1062-2023-0. Public domain.
